name: CANSURF
description: Surface-level marine debris remains a practical bottleneck for autonomous clean-up, where small, reflective targets (e.g., aluminum cans) must be detected at distance under glare, ripples, and partial submersion. This paper presents, an ASV vision system and a new surface-can dataset. The dataset comprises ~7.3k raw images extracted from videos and annotated with bounding boxes, expanded via ten augmentation types to ~57k training/validation images spanning diverse lighting and water states. A family of detector and detector-tracker pipelines tailored to surface operations were benchmarked.
